memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, works as vegetable vendor, walks to market daily.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, amlodipine 5 mg OD).
mood: Reports good mood, no anxiety.
carers: Wife (Spouse).
goals: "Stay healthy to support my family and keep working."

memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST-T changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmias.

memories.text: I’ve noticed my ankles swell by evening, especially after a hot day at the market. It’s uncomfortable but not painful.
